meta.description: Analyzes single-cell pooled CRISPR screens (Perturb-seq, CROP-seq, Perturb-CITE-seq, ECCITE-seq, multiome) where each cell carries an sgRNA and a scRNA-seq/surface-protein/chromatin readout. Covers experimental design, MOI/sgRNA assignment, Mixscape escaper filtering, SCEPTRE low-MOI DE, the Pertpy framework, genome-scale Perturb-seq, and per-perturbation single-cell DE.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/statistics across any of the 9 outputs; all synthetic fixtures explicitly labeled as synthetic and independently re-generated (not reused from the fixer); real-data results (Input 1) traced directly to pt.dt.papalexi_2021() output.

practice_boundaries.detail: SKILL.md now carries an explicit '## Scope' section (verified present, substantive, not a stub) stating research-only use and disclaiming individual patient-treatment application; Input 7's refusal is now backed by the Skill itself, not only agent judgment.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled statistical fallacy found. The genome-scale scaling formula (Input 5) was independently re-derived by hand: 19000/9866=1.926, giving $96-193K and 19-58 channels, consistent with SKILL.md's stated ~$95-190K/~19-57 channels.

code_usability.detail: Every generated/executed code path (PyDESeq2 contrast API on both a fresh synthetic pseudobulk fixture and the real papalexi_2021() dataset, Mixscape on real data, the Multiome RNA+ATAC workflow on an independent synthetic fixture, sgRNA assignment, SCEPTRE) ran to a correct, independently-verified result with zero adaptation needed -- an improvement over the pre-fix audit, which required a 2-line adaptation to reach the same result.

functional_suitability.note: Both verified correctness defects from the pre-fix audit (stale PyDESeq2 contrast API/columns; unscaled genome-scale cost figures) are fixed and independently reverified against real data and hand arithmetic; broad, accurate coverage otherwise unchanged.

reliability.note: Failure Modes/Common Errors tables remain accurate (reproduced the 74%-escaper pattern on real data); the perturbation_signature() determinism gap that previously dinged idempotency is fixed and independently confirmed byte-identical across two OS processes.

performance_context.note: Unchanged: SKILL.md remains dense (~345 lines) with most tables inline, but stays well under the ceiling; usage-guide.md's redundancy pass tightened the split further.

agent_usability.note: Unchanged: strong stepwise workflow and concrete thresholds; the NTC/NT terminology inconsistency is now explicitly annotated inline (not silently present) but the two placeholder conventions were deliberately left as-is rather than unified, so this is only a partial improvement.

human_usability.note: Unchanged: Quick Start prompts and Prerequisites remain accurate and well-matched to real researcher phrasing.

security.note: Unchanged: no credentials, no eval/exec of raw strings, no PHI handling; standard research-code posture.

maintainability.note: The one bundled 'runnable' example (examples/run_pertpy.py) now actually runs end-to-end on real data with zero adaptation, closing the pre-fix audit's main maintainability gap; usage-guide.md/SKILL.md redundancy was also collapsed per the fix log's dedup pass.

agent_specific.note: The pre-fix audit's main Agent-Specific gap (no Escape Hatches / scope-boundary language anywhere) is fixed: a substantive '## Scope' section now exists and was independently confirmed via Input 7. Trigger precision and Related Skills cross-referencing remain strong and unchanged.

inputs.label: Mixscape escaper filtering + PyDESeq2 pseudobulk DE end-to-end on the real papalexi_2021() dataset
inputs.note: Executed for real (pertpy 1.3.0, real pt.dt.papalexi_2021() MuData, 20,729 cells x 18,649 genes, 26 gene_target values). Independently reproduced both extra-bug preconditions (gene_target absent from adata.obs before merge; post-normalization values non-integer) then ran the fixed pipeline: Mixscape (NP 13648 / KO 4695 / NT 2386) -> PyDESeq2 fit (layer='counts', zero errors) -> 6 real-target contrasts. All 6 (STAT1, IFNGR2, IFNGR1, JAK2, IRF1, MYC) recovered textbook-correct biology (IFN-stimulated genes for the IFN-pathway KOs; ribosomal protein genes for MYC) -- broader independent validation than the fixer's own single-target spot-check.
